tei:div.tei:p: (na)༄༅// ston pa nye ba'i sras brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa dkyil 'khor gcig tu mchod cing bsags sbyong bya ba'i cho ga rgyal sras dgyes pa'i lam 'jug ces bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo gu ru bud+dha bo dhi sa twa bh+yaḥ dus gsum gshegs pa rgyu skar phreng ba'i dbus// thugs bskyed zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rab mdzes pa// shākya'i gtso dang nye ba'i sras brgyad la// gus pa'i yid kyis lan brgyar bsngags shing 'dud// yongs su grags kyang 'di tshul ma grags la// khyad par med kyang khyad chos mang ldan pa// smra mkhas mang pos ma smras don gang de// dad pa kho nas phyogs tsam mtshon par bya// de'ang 'phags pa dkyil 'khor brgyad pa zhes bya ba'i mdo las/ des na lci ba gsar bsres pa'i// dkyil 'khor gru bzhi lham par bya// sems can kun dang thun mong du// 'das pa'i sangs rgyas gang yin dang*// gang dag ma 'ongs da ltar byung*// byang chub sems dpa'i nyan thos dang*// rang sangs rgyas dag gang yod pa// de dag rnams la yongs su bsngo// de nas dkyil 'khor khor yug tu// 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rnams bya ste// 'jig rten dbang dang byams pa dang*// thub pa skyes mchog nam mkha' dang*// kun tu bzang po blo ldan dang*// gsang ba pa yi bdag po dang*// 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa dang*// sgrib pa thams cad rnam sel dang*/ de bzhin sa yi snying po ste// de dag gi ched du dkyil 'khor brgyad bya'o// zhes dang*/ de'i dgos pa dmigs bsal bcas gsungs pa ltar de bzhin gshegs pa nye ba'i sras dang bcas pa dkyil 'khor gcig tu mchod cing*/ theg pa chen po'i dge ba'i rtsa ba bsags sbyong spel gsum gyi sgo mtha' yas pa sgrub pa la gnyis/ rten dang mchod tshogs 'du bya ba/ nyams len cho ga'i rim pa'o// dang po ni/ gtsang zhing yid du 'ong ba'i gnas khang byi dor byas shing rgyan dang bkod pas spras pa'i gung du spyi dang khyad par gyi sku gsung thugs rten bzhugs su gsol ba'i mdun phyogs stegs bu gru bzhi par ba'i rnam lnga dang dri bzang byugs pa'i dbus dang phyogs mtshams brgyad du rin po che'i maṇ+ḍal re re ste gtso 'khor dgu bkod pa la rdul tshon gyis pad+ma 'dab brgyad re bris pa'i lte bar me tog gi tshom bu re dgod/

dbus su thub pa'i dbang po'i sku brnyan/ gzhan brgyad la nye sras rnams kyi sku gzugs bris 'bur ci 'byor bzhugs pa'i mtha' skor du spyi mchod me tog la sogs pa re re nas brgya rtsa dang*/ sgos mchod maṇ+ḍal dgu la nyer spyod cha dgu bshams pa ni rgyas pa yin la/ 'bring du byed na spyi mchod med pa'i sgos mchod tsam bsham/ 'byor pas mi lcogs pa la bsdu na maṇ+ḍal gcig la dri'i thig le dang tshom bu dgu bkod pa'i dbus su ston pa'i sku brnyan tsam 'dzom na bkod la ma 'byor na'ang 'gal ba med cing*/ mtha' skor du mchod pa cha gcig tsam bshams la so so'i sgos mchod skabs 'bru sogs kyis kha gso bar bya'o// gang ltar mdun tu mchod yon dang zhabs bsil gyi snod/ chu gtsang gi bya ma bum/ bshos zlum rgyan ldan dkar mngar bza' bca'i rigs dang bcas pa/ bum pa bcud ldan me long sku phyi na bza' bcas khrus chas/ 'thor nas dang rol mo'i bye brag rnams kyang tshogs par bya'o// gnyis pa nyams len cho ga'i rim pa la gsum/ rnam par dag pa'i sbyor ba/ bsags sbyong spel gsum gyi dngos gzhi/ cho ga byas pa'i rjes kyi bya ba'o// dang po la gnyis/ byang chub sems kyis bsam sbyor rnam par dag par bya ba dang*/ byin rlabs bzhi skor gyis snod bcud rnam par dag par bya ba'o// dang po ni/ khrus dang gtsang sbra legs par byas te/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa mngon sum bzhin tu dmigs te phyag 'tshal ba'i gzungs brjod la phyag lan gsum bya/ 'grub na theg chen gyi gso sbyong blangs la tshul khrims rnam dag gi gzungs bzla/ gang ltar brjod don la mnyam par bzhag ste/ gang gi rten cing 'brel par 'byung*// 'gag pa med pa skye med pa// chad pa med pa rtag med pa// 'ong ba med pa 'gro med pa// tha dad don min don gcig min// spros pa nyer zhi zhir bstan pa// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas smra rnams kyi// dam pa de la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes dang*/

gang zhig rkyen las skyes pa de ma skyes// de la skye ba'i rang bzhin yod ma yin// rkyen la rag las gang de stong pa ste// gang gis stong nyid shes de bag yod yin// ces shes rab stong nyid spros bral gyi ting nge 'dzin la ci nus su blo bzhag de las langs nas thabs snying rje chen pos kun la khyab par bltas te/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang gnyis dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig ces tshad med pa bzhi bsgom zhing*/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la// byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi// bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa 'di dag gis// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces pa lan gsum gyis byang chub kyi sems yid la byed do// gnyis pa la bzhi las/ dang po sa gzhi byin rlabs ni/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*/ byin rlabs dang*/ tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mthu dang*/ chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin gyi yon tan dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi zhing dag pa'i sbyor ba la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su sbyangs pa'i mthu dang*/ bdag cag rnams kyi mos pa'i mthu las gnas 'di sa gzhi rin po che sna bdun pa'i rang bzhin lag mthil ltar mnyam pa tha gru che zhing yangs pa/ reg na 'jam zhing bde ba/ lha'i me tog dri zhim pos gcal bkram pa/ yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i chu'i mtsho dang rdzing bu dang lteng ka rin po che'i phye ma gram bur bdal zhing nor bu'i pha gus mtha' brtsigs pa/ ut+pa la dang ku mu ta dang pad+ma du mas mdzes pa dang*/ chu bya skad snyan par sgrogs pa mang pos gang ba rnams dang*/ rin po che'i shing ljon pa sna tshogs rnam par rgyas pa la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi rgyan dang*/

bkod pa yon tan phun sum tshogs pa thams cad dang ldan par gyur cig gnyis pa gnas byin rlabs ni/ de'i dbus su gzhal med khang chen po rin po che sna bdun mchog tu 'bar ba bkod pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams dpag tu med pa rgyas par 'gengs pa'i 'od zer chen po rab tu 'byung ba/ gnas tha dad pa shin tu rnam par bye ba mtha' yas pa rnam par gnas pa/ rgya yongs su ma chad pa/ khams gsum las yang dag par 'das pa'i spyod yul 'jig rten las yang dag par 'das pa de'i bla ma'i dge ba'i rtsa ba las byung ba/ shin tu rnam par dag cing dbang sgyur ba'i rnam par rig pa'i mtshan nyid/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gnas/ byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang ldan pa/ lha dang klu dang gnod spyin dang dri za dang lha ma yin dang nam mkha' lding dang mi'am ci dang lto 'phye chen po dang mi dang mi ma yin pa mtha' yas pa rnam par rgyu ba/ chos kyi ro'i dga' ba dang bde ba chen pos brtan pa/ sems can thams cad kyi don thams cad yang dag par thob par byed pas nye bar gnas pa/ nyon mongs pa'i gnod pa'i dri ma thams cad dang bral ba/ bdud thams cad yongs su spangs pa/ thams cad kyi bkod pa las lhag pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i bkod pa'i gnas/ dran pa dang blo gros dang rtogs pa chen pos nges par 'byung ba/ zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gi bzhon pa yin pa/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang*/ mtshan ma med pa nyid dang*/ smon pa med pa nas 'jug pa/ rin po che'i pad+ma'i rgyal po yon tan mtha' yas pas brgyan pa'i bkod pa la brten pa'i gzhal med khang chen por gyur/ gsum pa gdan byin rlabs ni/ de'i dbus su lha dang klu dang mi la sogs pa'i rin po che sna tshogs pa'i khri'i steng du lha mi'i gos rin thang med pa bting ba'i steng du/ gtsang zhing dri ma med pa'i pad+ma'i ze'u 'brur zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ phyogs mtshams rnams su pad zla'i gdan re re/

gzhan yang rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i bzhugs gnas pad+ma'i gdan sna tshogs pa bshams pa so sor gsal bar gyur/ bzhi pa mchod pa byin rlabs ni/ khri de dag gi steng du rin po che sna tshogs dang lha dang mi'i gos sna tshogs las grub pa'i gdugs dang bla bre dang 'phan dang lda ldi dang lha'i me tog man dā ra ba la sogs pa rnams kyi char dang*/ bla res dang gdugs dang 'phan dang*/ lda ldi la sogs pa mdzes par bres shing*/ logs rnams kyang rin po che dang*/ dar dang me tog la sogs pa'i drwa ba dang drwa phyed dang 'phan dang lda ldi la sogs pas mdzes pa dang*/ sa gzhir lha dang mi'i me tog sil ma bkram zhing*/ mchod yon me tog bdug spos mar me dri chab zhal zas rol mo la sogs pa phung po gsum pa'i mdo dang bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam las 'byung ba lta bu'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi rgya mtsho phul du byung zhing sna tshogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa nam mkha'i khams kyi mtha' klas par rgyas par gang zhing zad mi shes pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ badz+ra sā ra pra mar+dha ni/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samya k+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ badz+re badz+re ma hā badz+re/ ma hā te dzo badz+re/ ma hā bid+ya badz+re/ ma hā bo dhi tsit+ta badz+re/ ma hā bo dhi maṇ+ḍo pa saṃ kra ma ṇa badz+re/ sarba karma ā pa ra ṇa bi sho dha na badz+re swā hā/ lan gsum rol mo bsgrag de nas thun mong du byin gyis brlab pa ni/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*/ byin rlabs dang*/ tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mthu dang*/ chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin gyi yon tan dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi zhing dag pa'i sbyor ba la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su sbyangs pa'i mthu dang*/ bdag cag rnams kyi mos pa'i mthu las de de bzhin tu gyur cig ces bden pa'i stobs lan gsum brjod par bya'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis/ tshogs zhing spyan 'dren yan lag dang bcas pa/

tshogs bsags pa'i rim pa'o// dang po la drug las/ thog mar snyan gsan dbab pa ni/ dad gus chen pos pus btsugs thal mo sbyar te me tog bkram/ spos thogs la/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag pa la rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya'i dbang po la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa dang*/ spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang*/ rdo rje 'dzin pa dang*/ byams pa mgon po dang*/ 'phags pa sa yi snying po dang*/ sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba dang*/ nam mkha'i snying po dang*/ kun tu bzang po rnams rang rang gi 'khor rgya mtsho lta bus bskor ba rnams dang*/ dam pa'i chos skyong ba'i zhabs 'bring gi tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi nyes ltung gi dri ma sbyang zhing bsod nams kyi tshogs spel ba'i slad du spyan 'dren zhing mchis na thugs rje chen pos bskul te deng dus la bab kyis dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ gnyis pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha// dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i// bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// bcom ldan bskal pa grangs med du ma ru// 'gro la brtse phyir thugs rje rnams sbyangs shing*// smon lam rgya chen dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa'i// khyed bzhed 'gro don mdzad dus 'di lags na/ de phyir chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub nas// rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs sna tshogs ston mdzad cing*// mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams bsgral ba'i phyir// yongs bdag 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol// tshul khrims rnam dag shes rab shin tu dag /dad ldan snying po nyan thos che rnams kyis// mgon med gyur pa bdag la rjes bzung ba'i// don mdzad thugs rjes dgongs par mdzad du gsol/

phyogs bcu'i zhing na rnam 'phrul sna tshogs kyis// 'gro ba'i don brtson sems dpa' chen po brgyad// gdul bya'i yul la thugs rjes brtser dgongs te// 'dir gshegs mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i dbus bzhugs gsol// gsum pa mchod yon 'bul zhing zhabs bsil ba ni/ bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs// bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan// bdag gi mchod yon bzhes slad du// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// mchod yon gyi chu bzed zhal du sbrengs la/ rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang*// sems can lus ngag yid gsum gdung ba sel slad du// yan lag brgyad ldan chu gtsang yid du 'ong ba 'di// bzhes shig bzhes shig bdag gi mchod yon 'di dag go /btung ba phul ba'i bsod nams kyis// nyon mongs bkres skom zhi ba dang*// sbyin sogs yon tan ldan pa yi// skom dad med par skye bar shog /chu dhūrba'i chun pos blangs te chol zangs su zhabs bkru ba'i tshul bya zhing*/ ngang pa'i mchog ltar sor mo drwa bas 'brel// 'khor lo'i mtshan can mdzes pa'i zhabs zung la// dag byed phul bas skye bo ma lus pa// rdzu 'phrul rkang pa mchog dang ldan gyur cing*// bzhi pa khrus gsol ba ni/ phyag len mthong brgyud ltar byas la/ khrus khang bskyed pa ni/ khrus kyi khang pa shin tu dri zhim pa// shel gyi sa gzhi gsal zhing 'tsher bar bstar// rin chen 'bar ba'i ka ba yid 'ong ldan// mu tig 'od chags bla re bres pa der// dri dang bcas pa'i 'dag chal dūrbas byug cing*/ stong gsum kun tu dri ngad ldang ba yi// dri mchog rnams kyis thub dbang rnams kyi sku// gser sbyangs btso ma byi dor byas pa ltar// 'od chags 'bar ba de dag byug par bgyi// khrus gsol ni/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kun gyis khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol// 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan// thugs rje'i chu ni bla na med// byin rlabs ye shes chu yis ni// ci 'dod dngos grub stsal du gsol// de bzhin gshegs dang de yi sras rnams la// rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chus// yid 'ong legs par bkang ba glu dang ni// rol mor bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol// de dag gi bar mtshams rnams su mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs sngags dang*/

bsdu na rten snying brjod cing rol mo bya/ sku phyi zhing*/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos// gtsang la dri rab bsgos pas sku phyi'o// gos zung ngur smrig 'bul zhing*/ de nas de la kha dog legs bsgyur ba'i// na bza' shin tu dri zhim dam pa 'bul// gos bzang srab la 'jam pa sna tshogs dang*// rgyan mchog brgya phrag de dang de dag gis// 'phags pa kun tu bzang dang 'jam dbyangs dang*// 'jig rten dbang phyug sogs la'ang brgyan par bgyi// sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu ltar rab bkra zhing*// gang la reg na bde ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba'i// gos bzang rin chen bdag blo sbyang phyir 'bul// bzod pa dam pa'i gos kyis brgyan par shog /lnga pa bzhugs gsol ni/ rin chen du ma las grub seng ge'i khri// yid 'phrog sna tshogs gos kyis bkab pa 'di// sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa phul ba yis// 'gro kun rdo rje'i gdan la 'khod par shog /stong gsum kun dang mnyam pa yi// pad+ma 'dab brgyad ge sar bcas// bde zhing yangs par 'bul lags na// ci bde bar ni bzhugs su gsol// drug pa gsal gdab pa ni/ so so'i zhing khams nas sngon gyi thugs dam las brtsams te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdzu 'phrul chen pos nam mkha'i lam las mngon par gshegs te gzhal med khang gi nang du gdan so so la bzhugs pa ni/ dbus su ston pa bcom ldan 'das dpal rgyal ba shākya thub pa sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu/ mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas sa gnon dang g.yon mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ mchog gi sprul pa'i sku tshangs par spyod pa'i cha lugs can/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ phyogs mtshams kyi pad+ma rnams la shar nas g.yas skor du 'phags pa 'jam dpal gur gum gyi mdog can/ phyag gnyis thugs kar chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i g.yon pas po tis mtshan pa'i ut+pa la'i sdong bu 'dzin pa/

zur phud lnga pa gzhon nu'i cha lugs can/ 'jig rten mgon po ston zla ltar dkar pa ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon gdan la brten pas pad+ma dkar po'i sdong bu 'dzin pa/ ri dwags kyi pags pa phrag pa g.yon pa la bkal ba/ phyag na rdo rje sngon po bzhad pa'i stabs can rin po che'i prog zhu gsol ba/ phyag g.yas thugs kar 'bar ba'i rdo rje gsor zhing g.yon gdan la brten pa zla ba'i rgyab yol can/ byams pa mgon po dmar ser ral pa'i thor tshugs kyi ngos la byang chub chen po'i mchod rten can/ phyag gnyis bshad pa'i phyag rgya mdzad pa'i g.yon pas klu shing gi yal ga me tog dang bcas pa snyan gyi thad kar kha bye ba 'dzin pa/ tshangs par spyod pa'i cha lugs dar gyi smad dkris can ri dwags pags pas nu ma g.yon pa bkab pa/ sa'i snying po ser po stod g.yogs ser po can/ zhi tshul spyan rtsa dmar zhing me tog sngon po'i phreng pas thod bcings pa/ phyag g.yas shing rtog dang g.yon pad+ma'i steng na nor bus mtshan pa 'dzin pa/ 'od zer ljang gu 'phro ba/ sgrib pa rnam sel dkar po phyag g.yas bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin cing*/ g.yon pad+ma dkar po'i sdong bu 'dzin pa snyan gyi thad kar kha bye ba'i steng na zla ba nya gang ba ra ri med cing 'od zer 'phro ba/ nam mkha'i snying po sngo sang na bza' sngon po can/ phyag gnyis thugs kar chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i g.yon pas pad+ma'i rtsa ba 'dzin pa snyan gyi thad kar kha bye ba'i steng na ral gri sngon pos mtshan pa/ spyan gyi 'od kyis nam mkha' thams cad 'od dang dri zhim pos khyab par mdzad pa/ kun tu bzang po dmar po g.yas gang ba'i bum pa thugs kar gtod cing*/ g.yon nyi ma dang bcas pa'i pad+ma dkar po bsnams pa/ thams cad kyang dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyang gzi brjid dpag tu med pa 'phro zhing rang rang gi rigs kyi 'khor dpag tu med pas bskor ba/

gzhan yang nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang dam pa'i chos skyong ba rgya mtsho bcas mngon sum du bzhugs shing*/ bdag dang sems can thams cad la thugs rje chen pos dgongs par gyur/ ces gsal gdab bo// gnyis pa tshogs bsags pa'i rim pa la gsum/ yan lag bdun pas bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa/ sems bskyed gsum gyis ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa/ khyad par gyi phyag mchod smon lam gzungs sngags bzlas pas rdzogs smin sbyong gsum mthar phyin par byed pa'o// dang po la bdun las/ thog mar phyag 'tshal ba ni/ gnas lnga sa la 'dud pa'i phyag 'tshal bzhin tu/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba/ kha lo sgyur ba/ bla na med pa lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas mu med pa dag na/ dus gsum du gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rab 'byams ma lus pa'i dkon mchog thams cad la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// ji snyed su dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na// dus gsum gshegs pa mi yi seng ge kun// bdag gis ma lus de dag thams cad la// lus dang ngag yid dang bas phyag bgyi'o// bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam stobs dag gis// rgyal ba thams cad yid kyis mngon sum du// zhing gi rdul snyed lus rab btud pa yis// rgyal ba kun la rab tu phyag 'tshal lo// rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed sangs rgyas rnams// sangs rgyas sras kyi dbus na bzhugs pa dag /de ltar chos kyi dbyings rnams ma lus par// thams cad rgyal ba dag gis gang bar mos// de dag bsngags pa mi zad rgya mtsho rnams// dbyangs kyi yan lag rgya mtsho'i sgra kun gyis// rgyal ba kun gyi yon tan rab brjod cing*// bde bar gshegs pa thams cad bdag gis bstod// thabs mkhas thugs rjes shākya'i rigs 'khrungs shing*// gzhan gyis mi thub bdud kyi dpung 'joms pa// gser gyi lhun po lta bur brjid pa'i sku// shākya'i rgyal po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// gang tshe rkang gnyis gtso bo khyod bltams tshe// sa chen 'di la gom pa bdun bor nas// nga ni 'jig rten 'di na mchog ces gsungs// de tshe mkhas pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// gang tshe khyod bltams dog sa rab g.yos dang*// dzam+bu'i grib mas khyod sku ma btang dang*// 'di dang lan gsum kun gzigs mkhyen ldan pa// sangs rgyas khyod kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// mtshan mchog ldan pa dri med zla ba'i zhal// gser mdog 'dra ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// rdul bral khyod 'dra srid pa gsum ma mchis// mnyam med mkhyen chen khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// mi mchog 'dul ba kha lo sgyur mdzad cing*// kun sbyor 'ching ba gcod mdzad de bzhin gshegs// dbang po zhi zhing nyer zhi zhi la mkhas// mnyan yod bzhugs pa de la phyag 'tshal lo// rnam dag sku mnga' mchog tu gzugs bzang ba// ye shes rgya mtsho gser gyi lhun po dang*// grags pa 'jig rten gsum na lhang nge ba// mgon po dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// chos kyi dbyings na skyes bu gcig pu pa// khams gsum dag na btsun pa spyan ras gzigs// zla zhal pad mdog dri ma med pa'i sku// skyon bral thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal /log 'dren bgegs kyi tshogs rnams 'joms mdzad pa// bcom ldan rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo// byams chen me yis zhe sdang bud shing bsregs// ye shes 'od kyis ma rig mun pa sel// chos kyi rgyal tshab 'gro ba'i mgon gyur pa'i// dga' ldan bzhugs pa de la phyag 'tshal lo// gdul bya'i zhing du 'gro don rdzogs mdzad phyir// mi bsnyel thugs rjes 'khor ba'i mtha' la gzigs// thabs mkhas thugs rjes 'gro don lhur mdzad pa// sa yi snying po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// zhing rnams skus khyab zab yangs gsung sgra can// ji lta ji snyed thams cad mkhyen pa'i thugs// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas skyed mdzad pa// sgrib pa rnam par sel la phyag 'tshal lo// grags pa chen po 'gro ba kun gyi skyabs// zhal ras rgya che nam mkha'i spyod yul can// sa yi dkyil 'khor thams cad snang mdzad pa// nam mkha'i snying po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo*// rgyal sras dbus na yid bzhin nor bu ltar// sras dang bcas pa'i rgyal bas rab tu bsngags// smon lam rnam thar mkha' bzhin tshad med pa// kun tu bzang po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba ma lus dang*// byang chub sems dang rgyal sras ma lus tshogs// rdul cig steng na rdul snyed bzhugs pa yi// bla med 'phags pa'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo// ston pa bla med sangs rgyas rin po che// skyob pa bla med dam chos rin po che// 'dren pa bla med dge 'dun rin po che// bla med dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// phyag byar 'os pa thams cad la// zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi// lus btud pa yis rnam kun tu// mchog tu dad pas phyag 'tshal lo// gnyis pa mchod pa la thog mar bstod pas mchod pa ni/ rgyas par spro na thub dbang gi bstod pa rgyas bsdus/ nye sras brgyad kyi bstod pa rgya bod na byung ba spyi dang bye brag kho bos sbyar ba'i nor bu'i rgyal po rjes su sgrog pa'i sprin chen rnam brgyad bklag

dkyus su rgyal ba ma pham pa'i gsung rab spyi bstod 'di nyid bya ste/ sems can rnams la brtse ba can// 'phrad dang bral ba'i dgongs pa can// mi 'bral ba yi dgongs pa can// phan bde dgongs khyod la phyag 'tshal// thub pa sgrib kun nges par grol// 'jig rten thams cad zil gyis gnon// khyod kyi mkhyen pas shes bya khyab// thugs grol khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// sems can dag ni thams cad kyi// nyon mongs ma lus thams cad 'dul// nyon mongs 'joms mdzad nyon mongs la// brtse bcas khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// lhun gyis grub cing chags mi mnga'// thogs pa mi mnga' rtag par ni// mnyam par bzhag cing 'dri kun gyi// lan ldog khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// rten dang brten pa bshad bya dang*// gsung dang mkhyen pa 'chad byed la// blo gros rtag thogs mi mnga' ba// legs ston khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// gshegs nas spyod pa mkhyen mdzad de// de dag skad kyis sems can gyi// 'ong dang 'gro dang nges 'byung la// legs 'doms khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// lus can kun gyis khyod mthong na// skyes bu dam pa lags par 'tshal// mthong pa tsam gyis rab dang bar// mdzad pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// len dang gnas dang gtong pa dang*// sprul dang yongs su sgyur ba dang*// ting nge 'dzin dang ye shes la// mnga' brnyes khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// thabs dang skyabs dang dag pa dang*// theg chen nges par 'byung ba la// sems can rnams la rab slu ba'i// bdud 'joms khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// rang gzhan don tu ye shes dang*// spangs dang nges 'byung bgegs mdzad par// ston mdzad mu stegs gzhan dag gis// mi brdzi khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// bsrung med bsnyel ba mi mnga' ba// 'khor gyi nang na bag brkyang gsung*// kun nas nyon mongs gnyis spangs pa// 'khor sdud khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// kun mkhyen khyod la rgyu ba dang*// gnas pa kun la rtag par ni// kun mkhyen min spyod mi mnga' ste// yang dag don ldan khyod phyag 'tshal// sems can kun gyi bya ba la// khyod ni dus las mi 'da' bas// mdzad pa rtag tu don mnga' ba// mi bsnyel khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jig rten kun la nyin mtshan du// lan drug tu ni so sor gzigs// thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa// phan dgongs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// spyod pa dang ni rtogs pa dang*// ye shes dang ni phrin las kyis// nyan thos rang sangs rgyas kun gyi// bla ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// sku gsum dag gi byang chub che// rnam pa kun brnyes thams cad du// sems can kun gyi the tshom dag
/gcod pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dzin pa mi mnga' nyes mi mnga'// rnyog pa mi mnga' mi gnas pa// mi g.yo chos rnams thams cad la// spros med khyod la 'tshal lo// zhes dang*// ༈ //

'di nas kha skong yin pa 'dra/ 'phags pa byams pa'i gsang rab mdo sde rgyan las 'byung ba'i thub pa'i dbang po'i bstod pa sems brtse ma'i mjug spros med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pa'i mtshams/ thob bya'i yon tan kun brnyes pas// rang dang gzhan gyi phrin las sgrub// mkhyen par bya ba'i chos rnams kun// ma lus gzigs pa khyod phyag 'tshal// dran dang brtson 'grus ting nge 'dzin// rmad du byung ba'i dbang po stobs// byang chub yan lag 'phags pa'i lam// legs sgrub khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// khams gsum gtogs pa'i rnam par rtog /spangs pa'i snyoms 'jug rnam dgu yis// sems kyi tha ba 'joms pa'i dbang*// mthar son khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// gnyis su 'dzin pas rab stong zhing*// nye bar len pa smon mi mnga'// mtshan ma thams cad rab zhi bas// rnam thar mchog brnyes khyod phyag 'tshal// ye 'doms pa la// dbang bcu dag gis 'jig rten gyi// bya ba sgrub pa khyod phyag 'tshal// rmad byung lhun gyis grub pa can// shes bya kun la thogs med pa// sgrub dang spong ba'i ting 'dzin la// mnga' brnyes khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dzin dang 'chad pa chos kyi sgo// nyung ngus chos rnams bde blag tu// ston mdzad gzungs kyis chos kyi gter// kha 'byed khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// chags sogs dgag dka'i dri ma dang*// 'khor gsum rnam par rtog pa'i gzhi// bag chags bcas pa gtan spangs la// sgrib pa kun grol khyod phyag 'tshal// gsal dang dri med yon tan gter// phrin las rten dang brten pa yis// khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// khyod kyis zag bcas 'gro ba'i rgyun// gang lags lam gyi bden pas bsgyur// 'gro ba kun 'jug ye shes su// mkhyen pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jig rten slob ma bse rus sras// ston pa'i 'byor pa phul byung ba// gang lags de 'dra mnga' brnyes pas// legs 'byor khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// thun mong ba dang phul byung chos// rlabs chen shin tu rmad byung ba// brnyes pas 'jig rten thams cad kyi// skyabs gyur khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// de lta'i dngos bstod ston pa yis// bstan pa rin chen gsal mdzad pas// 'gro ba kun gyis shes bya yi// de nyid legs par mthong bar shog

/ces chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i thub pa dgongs gsal gyi mjug tu 'byung ba nyid kha skong du sbyar gsungs pa ltar nye sras mchod chog 'dir yang sbrel na legs so// //mtshan tsam thos pas bskal chen brgyad khri'i sdig /rab bsal byang chub lam las phyir mi ldog /da lta phyogs bcu'i zhing bzhugs 'dren pa rnams// slob tshe byang chub 'dzin tu stsal la 'dud// de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen snying po'i yan lag drug cus chos sgra sgrogs pa'i gsung*// ji lta ji snyed ye shes thugs mnga' ba// thub mchog shākya'i rgyal la gus pas bstod// gur gum mdangs 'dzin gzhon nu'i lang tsho can// glegs bam ze'u 'brus mdzes pa'i ut+pal bsnams// sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes mdzod 'chang ba// rgyal sras dpa' bo 'jam dpal zhabs la 'dud// kha ba mu tig mdog mtshungs pad dkar g.yon// dka' thub chas can ri dwags pags pa bsnams// rgyal kun brtse ba gcig bsdus 'jig rten mgon// 'khor ba dong nas sprugs par mdzad la 'dud// bai ḍūr+ya'i lhun po dang mtshungs gzi brjid 'bar// mthu stobs dbang brnyes rdo rje phyag na gsor// gsang ba kun bdag sras bcas rgyal kun la// glags lta'i bdud tshogs 'joms par mdzad pa 'dud// li khri'i mdangs can klu shing sdong bu bsnams/ thor tshugs gser gyi mchod sdong mdzes pas spras// tshangs spyod chos can thub pa'i chos mdzod srung*// rgyal tshab lha brgya'i mgon po'i zhabs la 'dud// gser mdog me tog sngon pos thod bcings shing*// shing tog pad+ma nor bus mtshan pa bsnams// brtan g.yo'i bcud spel dge ba'i lo tog skyed// 'jigs pa kun skyob sa yi snying por 'dud// chu shel mdog can bcud ldan bum bzang dang*// nya rgyas zla bas mtshan pa'i pad dkar bsnams// mtshan gyi zer tsam lhung bas sgrib pa'i mun// rnam par sel mdzad bde gshegs sras por 'dud// sprin med nam mkha'i mdangs can chos 'chad rgyas// ral gris mtshan pa'i ut+pal yu ba btegs// ltung bas 'jigs shing dge rtsa chad pa yi// 'gro skyob dpa' bo nam mkha'i snying por 'dud// nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ltar gsal bum pa dang*// pad dkar sdong bu nyin byed mtshan pa bsnams// bzang po spyod kun khyod kyi rjes slob pa// rgyal sar thu bo kun tu bzang por 'dud// bsam yas yon tan rgya mtsho'i bdag nyid can// sras bcas rgyal ba'i rnam thar rgya mtsho la// bstod dbyangs yan lag rgya mtshos dus kun tu// bsngags pas de 'dra'i go 'phang mngon byed shog

/ces pa tsam gyis bstod/ dngos 'byor gyi mchod pa ni/ me tog phal cher me tog bla bye dang*// me tog bkod pa'i 'od zer rab bkye zhing*// me tog sna tshogs kun tu bkram byas nas// bdag nyid chen po rgyal ba sras bcas mchod// des 'gres te/ bdug spos/ snag gsal/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo zhes sbyar ba dang*/ me tog dam pa phreng ba dam pa dang*// sil snyan rnams dang byugs pa'i gdugs mchog dang*// mar me mchog dang bdug spos dam pa yis// rgyal ba de dag la ni mchod par bgyi// na bza' dam pa rnams dang dri mchog dang*// phye ma phur ma ri rab mnyam pa dang*// bkod pa khyad par 'phags pa'i mchog kun gyis// rgyal ba de dag la yang mchod par bgyi// mchod pa gang rnams bla med rgya che ba// de dag rgyal ba thams cad la yang mos// bzang po spyod la dad pa'i stobs dag gis// rgyal ba kun la phyag 'tshal mchod par bgyi// bdag pos ma bzung ba'i mchod pa ni/ rin chen sems de bzung bar bya ba'i phyir// de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang dam pa'i chos// dkon mchog dri ma med dang sangs rgyas sras// yon tan rgya mtsho rnams la legs par mchod// me tog 'bras bu ji snyed yod pa dang*// sman gyi rnam pa gang dag yod pa dang*// 'jig rten rin chen ji snyed yod pa dang*// chu gtsang yid du 'ong ba ci yod dang*// rin chen ri bo dang ni de bzhin du// nags tshal sa phyogs dben zhing nyams dga' dang*// ljon shing me tog rgyan spras spud pa dang*// shing gang 'bras bzang yal ga dud pa dang*// lha sogs 'jig rten na yang dri dang ni// spos dang dpag bsam shing dang rin chen shing*// ma rmos 'khrungs pa'i lo tog rnam pa dang*// gzhan yang mchod par 'os pa'i rgyan rnams ni// mtsho dang rdzing bu pad+mas brgyan pa dang*// ngang pa shin tu skad snyan yid 'ong ldan// nam mkha' rab 'byams khams kyi mthar gtugs pa// yongs su bzung ba med pa de dag kun// blo yis blangs nas thub pa skyes kyi mchog

/sras dang bcas pa rnams la legs 'bul na// yon gnas dam pa thugs rje che rnams kyis// bdag la brtser dgongs bdag gi 'di dag bzhes// bdag ni bsod nams mi ldan bkren chen te// mchod pa'i nor gzhan bdag la cang ma mchis// des na gzhan don dgongs pa'i mgon gyis ni// bdag gi don slad nyid kyi mthus bzhes shig /lus dbul ba'i mchod pa ni/ rgyal dang de sras rnams la bdag gis ni// bdag gi lus kun gtan tu dbul bar bgyi// sems dpa' mchog rnams bdag ni yongs bzhes shig /gus pas khyed kyi 'bangs su mchi bar bgyi// bdag ni khyed kyis yongs su bzung ba na// srid na mi 'jigs sems can phan par bgyid// sngon gyi sdig las yang dag 'da' bgyid cing*// sdig pa gzhan yang slan chad mi bgyid do// khyad par gyi mchod pa ni/ stong gsum kun tu dri ngad ldang ba yi// dri mchog rnams kyis thub dbang rnams kyi sku// gser sbyangs btso ma byi dor byas pa ltar// 'od chags 'bar ba de dag byug par bgyi// thub dbang mchod gnas mchog la yid 'ong ba'i// me tog man+dā ra dang pad+ma dang*// ut+pa la sogs dri zhim thams cad dang*// phreng ba spel legs yid 'ong rnams kyis mchod// spos mchog yid 'phrog dri ngad khyab pa yi// bdug pa'i sprin tshogs rnams kyang de la dbul// zhal zas bza' btung sna tshogs bcas pa yi// lha bshos rnams kyang de la dbul bar bgyi// gser gyi pad+ma tshar du dngar ba yi// rin chen sgron me rnams kyang dbul bar bgyi// sa gzhi bstar ba spos kyis byugs pa der// me tog yid 'ong sil ma dgram par bgyi// gzhal med pho brang bstod dbyangs yid 'ong ldan// mu tig rin chen rgyan 'phyang mdzes 'bar ba// dpag yas nam mkha'i rgyan gyur de dag kyang*// thugs rje'i rang bzhin can la dbul bar bgyi// rin chen gdugs mdzes gser gyi yu ba can// 'khor yug rgyan gyi rnam pa yid 'ong ldan// dbyibs legs blta na sdug pa bsgreng ba yang*// rtag tu thub dbang rnams la dbul bar bgyi// de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs// rol mo dbyangs snyan yid 'ong ldan// sems can sdug bsngal sim byed pa'i// sprin rnams so sor gnas gyur cig

/dam chos dkon mchog thams cad dang*// mchod rten rnams dang sku gzugs la// rin chen me tog la sogs char// rgyun mi chad par 'bab par shog /ji ltar 'jam dbyangs la sogs pas// rgyal ba rnams la mchod mdzad pa// de bzhin bdag gis de bzhin gshegs// mgon po sras dang bcas rnams mchod// yon tan rgya mtsho rnams la bdag /bstod dbyangs yan lag rgya mtshos bstod/ bstod dbyangs snyan sprin de dag la// nges par kun tu 'byung gyur cig /yid byung gi mchod pa ni/ maṇ+ḍal tshom bu so bdun ma tshigs bcad rgyas bsdus rnams dang*/ bdag gzhan lus ngag yid gsum dus gsum dge tshogs dang*// rin chen maṇ+ḍal bzang po kun bzang mchod pa'i tshogs bcas pa// blo yis blangs nas dkon mchog rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul// thugs rje'i dbang gis bzhes nas bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol// deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar// bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dang*// dus gsum dge ba'i dngos po rnams// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// gus pas khyed la 'bul bar bgyi// kun nas gzigs pa'i spyan ldan pa// yon gnas dam pa khyed rnams kyis// bdag la brtse bar nyer dgongs nas// bdag gi 'di dag bzhes su gsol// bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// maṇ+ḍal sngags dang 'dod gsol/ mnyes byed maṇ+ḍal sogs spyi ltar bya'o// de nas sdig pa bshags pa la rgyas par spro na gser 'od las 'byung ba'i sangs rgyas rkang gnyis sogs brjod/ dkyus su/ srid 'gro nyam ngar byis pa'i blo yis ni// shin tu mi bzad sdig pa gang bgyis pa// stobs bcu mnga' ba'i spyan sngar mchis nas ni// sdig pa de kun so sor bshags par bgyi// skye ba nyam nga srid pa nyam nga dang*// 'jig rten nyam nga g.yo sems nyam nga bar// lus kyi spyod pa nyam nga sna tshogs kyis// bdag gis sdig pa gang bsags de 'chags so// byis pa blun byas nyon mongs nyam nga dang*// sdig pa'i grogs dang 'phrad pa nyam nga dang*// srid pa nyam nga 'dod chags nyam nga dang*// zhe sdang gti mug mun pa nyam nga dang*/

ngal ba'i nyam nga dus kyi nyam nga dang*// bsod nams bsgrub pa nyam nga bdag gis kyang*// rgyal ba yang dag mngon sum mchis nas ni// sdig pa de kun so sor bshags par bgyi// zhes dang*/ spyod 'jug byed pa// rdo rje can la skyabs su mchi// sngon chad khyed kyi bka' las 'das// da ni 'jigs pa che mthong nas// khyed la skyabs su mchi lags kyi// 'jigs pa myur du bsal du gsol// zhes dang*/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dbang gis ni// lus dang ngag dang de bzhin yid kyis kyang*// sdig pa bdag gis bgyis pa ci mchis pa// de dag thams cad bdag gis so sor bshags// yan lag lhag ma rnams ni/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun dang sangs rgyas sras// rang rgyal rnams dang slob dang mi slob dang*// 'gro ba kun gyi bsod nams gang la yang*// gang rnams phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten sgron ma dag /byang chub rim par sangs rgyas ma chags brnyes// mgon po de dag bdag gis thams cad la// 'khor lo bla na med pa bskor bar bskul// mya ngan 'da' ston gang bzhed de dag la// 'gro ba kun la phan zhing bde ba'i phyir// bskal pa zhing gi rdul snyed bzhugs par yang*// bdag gis thal mo rab sbyar gsol bar bgyi// phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing bshags pa dang*// rjes su yi rang bskul zhing gsol ba yi// dge ba cung zad bdag gis ci bsags pa// thams cad bdag gis byang chub phyir bsngo'o// zhes dang*/

bcom ldan 'das dpal rgyal ba shākya'i dbang po dang nye ba'i sras chen po brgyad la sogs pa sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs te phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ mchod cing sdig pa bshags pa dang*/ dge ba la rjes su yi rang ba dang*/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul zhing mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba btab pa dang*/ de dag gi mthu dpal dang*/ byin gyi rlabs kyi stobs kyis bdag cag gi thog ma ma mchis pa'i 'khor ba nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur cig lus la nad med pa dang tshe ring bar gyur cig 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dpal phun sum tshogs pa la mnga' brnyes par gyur cig mthar tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs nas rdo rje'i sku chos kyi rgyal po sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi go 'phang brnyes par gyur cig yul khams thams cad du'ang mi nad dang phyugs nad dang lo nyes pa dang dgra'i gnod pa la sogs pa bkra mi shis pa'i bag ci yang mi 'byung bar gyur cig char chu dus su babs te lo phyugs 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang*/ bde skyid kyi dpal phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur cig sems can thams cad kyang bde ba dang ldan sdug bsngal dang bral te tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig gnyis pa ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa la gnyis/ kun rdzob sems bskyed dang*/ don dam sems bskyed bzung ba'o// dang po la gnyis/ zab mo lta brgyud dang*/ rgya chen spyod brgyud kyi lugs so// dang po la/ sbyor dngos mjug gsum yod pa'i thog mar skyabs 'gro dang tshogs bsags ni/ phyag gsum dang pus btsugs thal mo sbyar bas/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dus 'di nas bzung ste/ byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// sangs rgyas rnams la skyabs su mchi// chos dang byang chub sems dpa' yi// tshogs la'ang de bzhin skyabs su mchi// zhes lan gsum/

tshogs bsags rgyas par spyod 'jug las byung ba'i yan lag bdun pa ni/ dus gsum gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas kun// chos dang tshogs kyi mchog bcas la// zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi// lus btud pas ni bdag phyag 'tshal// byang chub sems kyi gzhi rnams dang*// mchod rten rnams la bdag phyag 'tshal// mkhan po de bzhin slob dpon dang*// brtul zhugs mchog la phyag 'tshal lo// gang la sems kyi dam pa rin chen de// skyes pa de yi sku la phyag 'tshal zhing*// gang la gnod pa byas kyang bde 'brel ba// bde ba'i 'byung gnas de la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes dang*/ rin chen sems de bzung bar bya ba'i phyir// zhes pa nas/ mgon po sras dang bcas rnams mchod// kyi bar dang*/ bdag ni mi shes gti mug pas// rang bzhin kha na ma tho dang*// bcas pa'i sdig pa gang yin las// gang yang rung ba bgyis pa rnams// mgon po'i spyan sngar mngon sum du// thal sbyar sdug bsngal 'jigs sems kyis// yang dang yang du phyag 'tshal te// de dag thams cad bshags par bgyi// 'dren pa rnams kyis bdag gi sdig /nongs pa lags par bzung du gsol// 'di ni bzang po ma lags pas// slan chad bdag ni yongs mi bgyid// sems can kun gyi ngan song gi// sdug bsngal ngal gso'i dge ba dang*// sdug bsngal can dag bder gnas la// dga' bas rjes su yi rang ngo*// byang chub rgyur gyur dge bsags pa// de la rjes su yi rang ngo*// lus can 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las// nges par thar la yi rang ngo*// skyob pa rnams kyi byang chub dang*// rgyal sras sa la yi rang ngo*// sems can thams cad phan mdzad pa'i// thugs bskyed dge ba rgya mtsho dang*// sems can phan par mdzad pa la// dga' bas rjes su yi rang ngo*// phyogs rnams kun gyi sangs rgyas la// thal mo sbyar te gsol ba ni// sems can sdug bsngal mun 'thoms la// chos kyi sgron me sbar du gsol// rgyal ba mya ngan 'da' bzhed la// thal mo sbyar te gsol ba ni// 'gro 'di ldongs par mi 'god cing*// bskal ba grangs med bzhugs par gsol// de ltar 'di dag kun byas te// dge ba bdag gis bsags pa gang*// des ni sems can thams cad kyi// sdug bsngal thams cad sel bar shog

/ces sam/ bsdu na bzang spyod las byung ba lta bu gang rigs bya/ dngos gzhi ni/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid snying po byang chub la mchis kyi bar du/ ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs kyis// byang chub thugs ni bskyed pa dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la// de dag rim bzhin gnas pa ltar// bdag kyang 'gro la phan don tu// byang chub sems ni bskyed bgyi zhing*// de bzhin du ni bslab pa la'ang*// rim pa bzhin du bslab par bgyi// lan gsum/ rjes ni/ deng dus bdag tshe 'bras bu yod// mi yi srid pa legs par thob// de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes// sangs rgyas sras su da gyur to// rgyal po blon po las dang po'i// ltung ba lnga lnga brgyad la sogs// rtsa ba dang ni yan lag gi// nyes ltung rnams kyis ma gos par// da ni bdag gis ci nas kyang*// rigs dang mthun pa'i las brtsam ste// skyon med btsun pa'i rigs 'di la// rnyog par mi 'gyur de ltar bya// bdag gis de ring skyob pa thams cad kyi// spyan sngar 'gro ba bde gshegs nyid dang ni// bar du bde la mgron du bos zin gyi// lha dang lha min la sogs dga' bar gyis// zhes brjod do// gnyis pa la bsam sbyor rang bzhin gsum du bshad pa'i dang po/ srid zhi gnyis la mi gnas pa'i byang chub la spro ba bskyed pa'i bsam pa sngon du 'gro bas/ sbyor ba smon 'jug so sor sbyor dngos mjug gsum re yod pa'i smon sbyor gsol gdab ni/ ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang sa chen po la rab tu bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi sa dang po bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu thugs bskyed pa de bzhin tu bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed du gsol/

lan gsum/ de nas skyabs 'gro khyad par can ni/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste/ snying po byang chub la mchis kyi bar du rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// 'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// tshogs rnams kyi mchog 'phags pa phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// lan gsum dang tshogs bsags yan lag ni/ ji snyed su dag sogs 'don par bya'o// smon pa'i dngos gzhi ni byams snying rje drag pos/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba skye ba 'di dang skye ba gzhan dang gzhan dag tu sbyin pa'i rang bzhin dang tshul khrims kyi rang bzhin dang sgom pa'i rang bzhin gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba ci bgyis pa dang*/ bgyid du bstsal ba dang*/ bgyid pa la rjes su yi rang ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba des/ ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang sa chen po la rab tu bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu thugs bskyed par mdzad pa de bzhin tu/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed par bgyi'o// sems can ma brgal ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi'o// ma grol ba rnams dgrol bar bgyi'o// dbugs ma phyin pa rnams dbugs dbyung bar bgyi'o// yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las bzla bar bgyi'o// lan gsum gyis blang*/ smon pa'i rjes ni/

deng dus bdag tshe 'bras bu yod// mi yi srid pa legs par thob// de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes// sangs rgyas sras su da gyur to// nyin mtshan dus drug byang sems bsgom// 'gro blos mi spang tshogs la 'bad// dkar nag chos bzhi blang dor bya// byang sems phan yon mi brjed par// da ni bdag gis ci nas kyang*// rigs dang mthun pa'i las brtsam ste// skyon med btsun pa'i rigs 'di la// rnyog par mi 'gyur de ltar bya// bdag gis de ring sogs sh+lo ka gcig bya'o// 'jug pa byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i sbyor ba gsol gdab ni/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams las bdag byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa yang dag par len par 'tshal gyi de la gnod pa ma mchis na bdag la thugs brtse ba'i slad du cung zad gsan cing stsal bar rigs so// lan gsum/ 'dun pa gso ba ni/ bdag sems can ma brgal ba rnams bsgral ba dang*/ ma grol ba rnams dgrol ba dang*/ dbugs ma phyin pa rnams dbugs dbyung bar bgyi'o// yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las bzla ba dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi gdung rgyun mi chad par 'dod cing de dag la bdag sems bskyed pa brtan pa dang*/ yid ma brtan par bgyi'o// lan gcig myur du sbyin par gsol ba ni/ dngos su bshams dang yid kyis sprul// bdag pos yongs su ma bzung dang*// bla na med pa'i mchod pa'i tshogs// ma lus blo yis blangs te 'bul// bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dang*// dus gsum dge ba'i dngos po kun// ma lus dkon mchog spyan sngar 'bul// 'gro ba'i skyabs gyur 'tshang rgya shog /rgyal dang de sras rnams la bdag gis ni// bdag gi lus kun gtan tu dbul bar bgyi// sems dpa' mchog rnams bdag ni yongs bzhes shig /gus pas khyed kyi 'bangs su mchi bar bgyi// zhes dang*/

tsog pur thal mo sbyar te/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bdag la byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa yang dag par blang ba myur du stsal du gsol/ lan gsum/ bar chad dri ba ni/ bla ma las len na don tshan so so nas dri dgos kyang rang gis len tshe/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba byang chub sems dpa' lags shing byang chub tu smon lam btab pa lags te/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa'i gzhi thams cad dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims de dag sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad las blang bar 'tshal lo// zhes brjod cing da ltar byang chub kyi sems skye bar 'gyur ro snyam du dga' ba bsgom/ 'jug pa'i dngos gzhi ni/ sems can gyi don du byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa blangs pa de byang chub ma thob kyi bar du rkyen cis kyang mi 'phrog par bsrung snyam pas pus btsugs thal mo sbyar te/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa dang sa chen po la bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la gsol bar 'tshal te/ de dag gi spyan sngar bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa'i gzhi thams cad dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims thams cad de/ sdom pa'i tshul khrims dang*/ dge ba'i chos sdud pa dang*/ sems can gyi don bya ba'i tshul khrims gang la 'das pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bslabs pa dang*/ ma byon pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bslab par 'gyur ba dang*/ phyogs bcu na da ltar bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad da ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa'i gzhi thams cad dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims thams cad de/ sdom pa'i tshul khrims dang*/ dge ba'i chos sdud pa dang*/ sems can kyi don bya ba'i tshul khrims de thams cad bdag gis yang dag par blang ngo*// lan gsum/ 'jug pa'i rjes chog las/

mkhyen par gsol ba ni/ phyogs bcur phyag bya zhing*/ spos dang me tog phul nas tsog pur 'dug ste/ bdag byang chub sems dpa' ming 'di zhes bgyi bas byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa yang dag par blangs pa la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dpang du gyur par phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas mu med pa dag tu bzhugs pa'i 'phags pa'i mchog lkog tu gyur kyang chos thams cad la lkog tu ma gyur pa'i thugs mnga' ba thams cad la mkhyen par gsol lo// zhes lan gsum brjod de phyag bya/ blangs pa'i phan yon/ deng dus bdag tshe 'bras bu yod/ sogs sh+lo ka gcig gsang bar gdams pa dang bslab bya bstan pa/ snod min rnams la gsang bya zhing*// pham 'dra bzhi dang nyes byas sogs// ltung bas ma gos tshul khrims gsum// legs par bsrung ba'i sgo nas ni// da ni bdag gis ci nas kyang*// sogs sh+lo ka gnyis brjod/ gtang rag gi mchod bstod ni/ ji ltar 'jam dbyangs la sogs pas/ sogs sh+lo ka gnyis dang*/ phyag 'tshal ba dang sogs/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid// thob nas nyes pa'i dgra rnams pham byas nas// skye rga na 'chi'i rba rlabs 'khrugs pa yi// srid pa'i mtsho las 'gro ba sgrol bar shog /ces pa rnams kyis 'jug pa'i rjes chog grub bo// gnyis pa don dam byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa ni/ gtso bor mnyam par bzhag pa nyid yin mod kyi/ 'dun pa sngon 'gro'i dbang gis dpang kong phyag rgya pa'i mdo yi dgongs pa slob dpon klu'i phyag bzhes jo bo'i chos chung las 'byung ba'i don bsdus/ sbyor dngos mjug gsum las dang po ni/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa mi dge so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rangs// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// byang chub sems ni bskyed bgyis nas// sems can thams cad mgron du gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog mdzad bzhin spyad// 'gro ba la phan phyir sangs rgyas shog

/lan gsum// dngos gzhi ni/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji ltar sngon gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis dngos po thams cad dang bral ba phung po dang khams dang skye mched dang gzung ba dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs pa chos bdag med pa mnyam pa nyid kyi rang gi sems gdod ma nas ma skyes la stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid kyi byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang dus 'di nas bzung ste/ byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du dngos po thams cad dang bral ba phung po dang khams dang skye mched dang gzung ba dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs pa chos bdag med pa mnyam pa nyid kyi rang gi sems gdod ma nas ma skyes pa stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid kyi byang chub kyi sems bskyed par bgyi'o// lan gsum/ rjes ni/ bsod nams 'di yis/ nas/ 'gro ba 'don par bgyi// byang chub sems ni rin po che// ma skyes pa rnams skye gyur cig /skyes pa nyams pa med pa dang*// gong nas gong du 'phel bar shog /byang chub sems dang mi 'bral zhing*// byang chub spyod la gzhol ba dang*// sangs rgyas rnams kyi yongs bzung zhing*// bdud kyi las rnams spong bar shog /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis ni// 'gro don thugs la dgongs 'grub shog /mgon po yis ni gang dgongs pa// sems can rnams la de 'byor shog /sems can thams cad bde dang ldan gyur cig /ngan 'gro thams cad rtag tu stongs par shog /byang chub sems dpa' gang dag sar bzhugs pa// de dag kun gyi smon lam 'grub par shog /ces pa rnams kyis 'grub bo// byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin ni bsam pa smon 'jug gi sems bskyed pa sngon tu song nas sbyor ba phar phyin drug dang bsdu dngos bzhi la bslabs pas 'bras bu thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa ste de'i rnam bzhag gzhan las shes par bya'o// sa bcad gsum pa khyad par gyi bya ba la gsum/

gtso 'khor re re bzhin phyag mchod smon lam gdab pa/ gzungs sngags bzlas pas thugs rgyud bskul ba/ spyir smon lam du bya ba'o// dang po ni/ rgyas pa'i skabs su thub pa'i dbang po'i mtshan brgya gzungs sngags dang bcas pa tshar gcig brjod/ de rjes 'di'i phyag mchod smon lam la 'jug des 'gres te 'jam dpal nas kun tu bzang po'i bar so so'i mtshan brgya gzungs 'dus sogs las 'byung ba rnams tshar re brjod pa dang sbrags dgos la/ dkyus su/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpal rgyal ba shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do skyabs su mchi'o// lan bdun/ 'phags pa'i tshogs de dag thams cad la mchod yon dang byug pa/ me tog dang bdug spos/ mar me dang zhal zas/ rol mo dang sil snyan/ gdugs dang ba dan la sogs pa dngos su ci 'byor ba 'di dag dang phyogs bcu na bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i lha dang mi'i rdzas dam pa bde ba'i yo byad phun sum tshogs pa thams cad dang gzungs dang rig pa'i mthu dang mos pa'i stobs kyis bskyed pa'i mchod pa'i sprin bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam las byung ba rgya mtsho thams cad kyis nam mkha'i khams kyi mtha' klas pa thams cad byas par bkang ste/ 'bul lo mchod do// che ge zhes bya ba dang*/ bdag cag gis thog ma ma mchis pa nas 'khor ba na 'khor ba'i tshe rabs thams cad du sdig pa mi dge ba'i las mdor na mi bgyi bar rigs pa'i las ni bgyis/ bgyi bar 'os pa'i las ma bgyis pa la sogs pa dngos sdig ci mchis pa thams cad yang dag par 'chags so// dus gsum gyi 'phags pa dang skye bo'i dge ba mtha' dag gi bsod nams thams cad la rjes su yi rang ngo*// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad la chos kyi 'khor lo bla na med pa bskor bar bskul lo// 'jig rten gyi sgron me gang dag mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul ston par bzhed pa de dag thams cad la mya ngan las mi 'da' bar 'jig rten gyi don mdzad cing yun ring du bzhugs par gsol bar 'tshal lo// deng rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i tshogs gdan 'dzom pa'i spyan sngar ston pa bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i mtshan nas brjod de tshogs bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba la brten nas/

sngon rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa chen po dang rin chen snying po la sogs pa'i drung du bdag cag gi ston pa thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa gang gis thugs ji ltar bskyed pa dang*/ thugs dam ji ltar bzhes pa de bzhin du bdag gis kyang rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i spyan sngar byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing bslab pa'i gzhi mtha' dag la rjes su bslab par bgyi'o// ston pa shākya'i dbang pos bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol tu snyigs ma lnga'i mun par chud pa'i sems can skyob pa ma mchis pa/ skyabs ma mchis pa/ dpung gnyen ma mchis pa/ sdug bsngal gyi snod du gyur pa'i sems can rnams la thugs brtse bas dgongs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che'i snying po'i drung du smon lam chen po lnga brgya btab cing byang chub tu dam bca' bar mdzad pa de'i tshe ston pa 'khor dang bcas pas kyang snying rje chen po dang ldan pa khyod kyis smon lam btab pa legs so legs so// zhes sogs bsngags pa brjod cing khyod ni ma 'ongs pa'i dus na 'jigs rten gyi khams mi mjed du de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa bde bar gshegs pa 'jig rten mkhyen pa skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba bla na med pa lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa zhes bya bar 'gyur ro// lo bzhi bcu rtsa lngas sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa de lta bu mang po dag byed par 'gyur ro// khyod mya ngan las 'das nas kyang dam pa'i chos lo stong gnas par 'gyur ro// dam pa'i chos nub nas kyang sku gdung rnams kyis smon lam btab pa de ltar 'gyur te ji skad smos pa de bzhin du yun ring por sems can rnams 'dul bar 'gyur ro// zhes lung bstan pa de bzhin tu/ bdag cag la sogs pa'i sems can thams cad kyang sems can rnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba smin par bgyid pa'i slad du/

dga' ldan gyi gnas las babs te 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po'i rigs su btsun mo dam pa'i mngal na gnas pa nye bar 'dzin par gyur cig de'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi zhing mi mjed snang ba chen pos khyab par gyur cig dge ba'i rtsa ba ma bskrun pa'i sems can rnams kyi rgyud la mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa bon 'debs par gyur cig dge rtsa skyes pa rnams kyi rgyud la ting nge 'dzin gyi myu gu bskyed pa dang theg pa gsum po dag las phyir mi ldog par gyur cig bdag gis sems dang po bskyed pas slad ma'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi snying rje chen po 'grub par gyur cig bdag kyang pha rol tu phyin pa drug la spyod cing gzhan yang pha rol tu phyin pa drug la 'god par gyur cig sems can 'phags pa'i nor bdun dang bral ba rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing stong pa rnams dang*/ dam pa'i chos spong ba rnams dang*/ 'phags pa la skur ba 'debs pa rnams dang*/ log par lta ba rnams dang*/ me dge ba'i rtsa ba dang 'grogs shing nyam nga ba thob pa rnams dang*/ lam ngan pas bcom par gyur pa'i sems can rnams kyi don tu spro ba brtan po'i stobs kyis pha rol tu phyin pa rnams la spyod par gyur cig sems can re re'i sems kyi rgyud la dge ba'i rtsa ba'i sa bon bzhag pa'i slad du bskal pa chen po bcur yang sems can dmyal ba dang yi dwags dang dud 'gro la sogs pa'i tshor ba la yang spro bar gyur cig sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la dge ba'i rtsa ba 'jog pa dang sangs rgyas thams cad la sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi mchod pa sna tshogs dag bgyid par gyur cig sangs rgyas re re las kyang sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rdul phra rab snyed kyi yon tan dag rtogs par gyur cig de na gnas pa'i sems can rnams kyang byang chub yang dag par 'dzin du stsol bar gyur cig nyan thos kyi theg pa pa dang*/

rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pa'i sems can rnams kyang rang rang gi byang chub la 'god par gyur cig 'jig rten na sangs rgyas 'byung ba ma mchis na yang drang srong gi brtul zhugs kyi sems can rnams dge ba bcu'i las dang ting 'dzin dang mngon par shes pa la sbyor bar gyur cig sems can lta ba la chags shing dbang phyug dang khyab 'jug dang nyi zla dang tshangs pa dang dbang po sogs la dad pa rnams la de dag gi gzugs kyis dge ba'i spyod pa rnams la sbyor bar gyur cig sems can ltogs shing bkres pa dang*/ sdug bsngal bar gyur pa rnams la bdag gi lus dang srog gis bskyab nus par gyur cig sems can sems kyi rgyud tshig pa rnams dang nyam nga ba thob pa'i bar dag dang por byang chub la btsud de pha rol tu phyin pa dang tshogs gnyis la sbyor nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa'i zhing de dag tu 'bul ba dang byang chub tu lung bstan pa thob par gyur cig sems can thams cad la sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan bkod pa'i smon lam 'dzin tu stsol ba dang de dag gis phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas chos ston pa rnams mthong zhing de dag gi drung du phyin nas mnyes pa sgrub par gyur cig rgyal ba nyi ma nub pa de'i tshe na bdag sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa bgyid par 'gyur zhing*/ sems can rnams bsod nams bgyi ba'i dngos po gsum po dag la sbyor bar gyur cig bdag mthong ba'i bud med dang yi dwags dang dud 'gro'i 'gro ba rnams kyang skye ba de'i tha mar gyur cig bdag gi spu'i khung bu ji snyed pa de snyed kyi sangs rgyas kyi sku skyes bu chen po'i mtshan dang dpe byad kyis legs par brgyan cing*/ sku de dag sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du 'gyed par gyur cig sems can bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag dag la chos ston par gyur cig theg pa gsum gyi rigs can rnams la rang rang gi theg pa'i chos ston pa la sogs chos ston pa dgu bcu rtsa lngas chos ston par gyur cig

sems can dpag tu ma mchis pa rnams te ting nge 'dzin dang gzungs kyi sgo rnams la bkod cing byang chub kyi rgyan rnams kyis mdzes par byed par gyur cig dge ba'i rtsa ba ma bskrun pa'i sems can rnams kyang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba la 'god pa dang slad kyis pha rol tu phyin pa drug la sbyor bar gyur cig dge ba'i chos la mi dga' ba rnams yan lag brgyad kyi tshul khrims dang*/ nongs pa lnga bgyid pa rnams dge bsnyen dang*/ dge rtsa chung ngu dga' ba rnams bslab pa'i gzhi bcu dang*/ dge rtsa thams cad tshol ba rnams bslab gzhi yongs rdzogs la 'god par gyur cig 'khor bzhi po dang rtsod pa dang kha ton la mngon par dga' ba rnams la'ang de dang mthun pa'i chos ston pa la sogs mdor na 'gro ba thams cad la gang 'dul gyi gzugs dang chos sna tshogs pa ston par gyur cig bdag yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i sku gdung rnams la rin po che sna tshogs dang rol mo sna tshogs kyi bar gyis mchod pa bgyis pa'am tha na sangs rgyas kyi mtshan gcig dang phyag gcig dang bskor ba gcig dang me tog gcig tsam gyi rgyus mchod pa bgyid par 'gyur ba de dag kyang bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin tu theg pa gsum po dag las slar mi ldog par gyur cig dam pa'i chos nub pa'i tshe na'ang sku gdung de dag las chos kyi sgra 'byung ba dang nad mtshon mu ge'i 'jigs pa las bskyab pa sogs nam yang 'jigs pa med par sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa sgrub par gyur cig 'phos ma thag tu de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa'i spyan sngar pad+ma'i gdan seng ge'i khri la brdzus te skyes shing skyes ma thag tu pha rol tu phyin pa drug rdzogs nas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mnyes par byed cing sems can thams cad kyang theg pa chen po'i lam la 'god par gyur cig/ ༈ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do skyabs su mchi'o// lan bdun/

'phags pa'i tshogs de dag sogs gong ltar brjod/ deng rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i tshogs gdan 'dzom pa'i spyan sngar 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i mtshan nas brjod de tshogs bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba la brten nas/ sngon de bzhin gshegs pa 'brug sgra dbyangs kyi rgyal po la sogs pa'i drung du 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas thugs ji ltar bskyed pa dang thugs dam ji ltar bzhes pa de bzhin tu bdag gis kyang rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i spyan sngar byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing bslab pa'i gzhi mtha' dag la rjes su bslab par bgyi'o// bdag cag rnams kyis sngon dang phyi ma'i mtha' mi mngon pa de srid du bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i go cha chen po gyon pa dang*/ 'jug pa chen pos yang dag par zhugs par gyur cig sems can gang su'ang rung bas bdag cag mthong bar gyur pa de dag bla na med pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog pa dang*/ bskal pa bye ba phrag nyi shur 'khor ba phyir bsnyil bar gyur cig pha rol tu phyin pa lnga yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig bud med gang gis bdag gi ming thos pa de dag myur du bud med kyi lus las thar bar gyur cig chos thams cad nam mkha' lta bur shes pa'i shes rab shin tu zab mos 'khor ba ji srid pa de srid du byang chub sems dpa'i spyad par spyod pa la ngal ba dang skyo ba med par gyur cig sangs rgyas kyi zhing gcig la gaṅgā'i klung du ma snyed kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su khyab pa'i tha gru tshad med pa grub pa dang*/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba khrag khrig phrag 'bum phrag tshad med grangs med pa dag na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan bkod pa'i rgyan ji snyed pa dag yod pa las nyan thos kyi bkod pa dang*/ snyigs ma lnga'i sangs rgyas rnams ma gtogs pa de dag thams cad bdag gis sangs rgyas kyi zhing gcig tu 'du ba de lta bu'i zhing gi bkod pa 'dzin par gyur cig

zhing der mngal nas skye ba med cing byang chub sems dpas gang ba dang*/ ngan song dang ngan 'gro'i sgra mi grags pa dang*/ sngon chad ma srid pa'i nor bu rin po che'i rgyal po du mas gang ba dang*/ zas gos longs spyod thams cad bsam ma thag nas 'byor la de dag gis kyang thog ma nyid du sangs rgyas mchod cing sems can thams cad tshim par byed pa'i dran pa dang mi 'bral ba dang*/ nyin mtshan dang tsha grang dang na rga 'chi ba med cing tshe'i grangs mthar thug pa med pa dang ldan par gyur cig zhing der bdag nyid mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan sgrib pa med pas phyogs bcur rnam par bltas pa na/ bdag gis sangs rgyas nyid la ma bkod pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa de lta bu gang yang ma mthong bar gyur pa de tsam du byang chub kyi spyod pa rlabs po che yongs su rdzogs par byed par gyur cig mdor na rgyal ba'i sras mchog 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i rnam thar dang gzungs dang ting nge 'dzin dang smon lam dang thabs la mkhas pa'i spyod yul dang rnam par 'phrul pa dang ye shes rgya mtsho tshad med pa thams cad bdag gis myur du 'grub nas sems can thams cad kyang de lta bu la 'god nus par gyur cig 'phos ma thag tu 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i zhal mngon sum du mthong ste sgrib pa ma lus pa skad cig la byang nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du thogs pa med par 'jug cing*/ zhing yongs su sbyong ba dang*/ sems can rnams smin par byed pa dang*/ dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin cing phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rnams la mnyes pa mtha' yas pa sgrub par byed par gyur cig/ ༈ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do skyabs su mchi'o// lan bdun/ mchod pa sogs gong bzhin bya/ deng rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i tshogs gdan 'dzom pa'i spyan sngar 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi mtshan nas brjod de tshogs bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba la brten nas/

sngon de bzhin gshegs pa bye ba phrag bcu'i drung du 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis thugs ji ltar bskyed pa dang thugs dam ji ltar bzhes pa de bzhin tu bdag gis kyang rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i spyan sngar byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing bslab pa'i gzhi mtha' dag la rjes su bslab par bgyi'o// sems can dmyal ba dang yi dwags dang dud 'gro'i skye gnas su skyes pa sdug bsngal mi bzad pas nyam thag pa rnams dang*/ mtho ris kun nas nyon mongs pa'i sems dang ldan pas 'di dang phyi mar 'jigs pas skrag pa rnams dang*/ mi dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang 'dres pas chos kyi mu ge'i mun par zhugs pa lta ba ngan pa'i 'dzin khris bzung ba rnams dang*/ mi dge ba bcu dang mtshams med pa lnga la spyod pa dang*/ chos dang gang zag la skur pa btab pa dang*/ mchod rten dang tshul khrims bshig pa dang*/ ltung ba'i rtsa ba byung ba dang*/ dkon mchog gi dkor la rku 'phrog bgyis pa la sogs pa dge ba'i rtsa ba chad cing skyabs dang skyob pa ma mchis pa/ dpung gnyen dang rten ma mchis pa thams cad kyis bdag rjes su dran par gyur cig de ma thag tu bdag gi lha'i mig dang rna bas mthong zhing thos nas sdug bsngal de dag las myur du thar bar byed nus par gyur cig bdag gi ming thos pa tsam gyis sems can thams cad sdig pa dang sgrib pa ma lus pa byang nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams rnam par dag par skye ba dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang spobs pa tshad ma mchis pa thob pa dang*/ tshe 'di'i 'jigs pa chen po rnams las thar zhing yid la ji ltar smon pa bde blag tu 'grub pa dang*/ bud med rnams kyang skyes pa'i dngos po thob par gyur cig bdag gi ming thos pa tsam gyis skye ba dran cing thos pa 'dzin pa dang bla na med pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par gyur cig nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can re re bzhin tu gang la cis gdul ba'i gzugs rnam pa sna tshogs su sprul nas bsam pa dang mthun par chos bstan te thams cad skad cig la grol bar gyur cig

sangs rgyas thams cad kyis ma btul ba'i snyigs ma lnga'i zhing dang mtha' 'khob tu skyes pa'i mi dang mi ma yin pa sha za dang gcan gzan gtum po gdug pa'i sems dang ldan pa thams cad kyang bdag gi ming thos pa dang thos ma thag tu byams pa dang snying rje'i sems rgyud la skyes te dam pa'i chos la spyod cing thar pa dam pa'i bde ba la 'god nus par gyur cig btsun pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje can khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag nges par ye shes chen po'i mig thob cing sems can thams cad yongs su skyob pa dang*/ myur du thabs la mkhas shing shes rab chen po'i grur zhugs pa dang*/ sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las brgal zhing mya ngan las 'da' ba'i ri la 'dzegs pa dang*/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang ldan cing lam myur du thob pa dang*/ 'dus ma byas kyi khyim du 'jug cing chos kyi sku dang gcig par gyur cig bdag ngan 'gro rnams su mchi ba na'ang de ma thag tu gnas de dag zhig cing stong nas bde ba dang ldan par gyur cig 'phags pa thugs rje'i dbang phyug bdag gis rjes su dran pa dang mtshan nas brjod pas/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal mi bzad pa dang 'jigs pa dang gnod pa dang phyir rgol ba thams cad rgyun chad par gyur cig las dang nyon mongs pa dang mi dge ba'i chos dang bdud kyi las thams cad byang zhing grol bar gyur cig 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi zhal mngon sum du mthong zhing dam pa dang smon lam gsol ba thams cad kyang myur du 'grub par gyur cig 'jig rten na nad dang mu ge dang mtshon cha dang me chu dang rlung la sogs pa'i gnod pa de dag zhi ba dang phongs shing nyam thag pa thams cad phan pa dang bde bar bgyid pa la mthu chen po thob par gyur cig 'chi 'pho ba thams cad kyang sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba med cing chos bdag med pa dang byang chub kyi sems brten pas dran pa nye bar bzhag cing 'phags pa'i zhal mngon tu mthong nas dbugs 'byin pa chen po mdzad par gyur cig

mdor na thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi rnam thar dang gzungs dang ting nge 'dzin dang smon lam dang thabs la mkhas pa'i spyod yul dang rnam par 'phrul pa dang ye shes rgya mtsho tshad med pa thams cad bdag gis myur du 'grub nas sems can thams cad kyang de lta bu la 'god nus par gyur cig 'phos ma thag tu spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi zhal mngon sum du mthong ste sgrib pa ma lus pa skad cig la byang nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du thogs pa med par 'jug cing*/ zhing yongs su sbyong ba dang*/ sems can rnams smin par byed pa dang*/ dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin cing phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rnams la mnyes pa mtha' yas pa sgrub par byed par gyur cig/ ༈ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gsang ba'i bdag po lag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do skyabs su mchi'o// lan bdun/ mchod pa sogs gong bzhin bya/ deng rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i tshogs gdan 'dzom pa'i spyan sngar dpal gsang ba'i bdag po'i mtshan nas brjod de tshogs bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba la brten nas/ sngon de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan mtha' yas rin chen sna tshogs bkod pa'i rgyal po la sogs pa gaṅgā'i bye ma snyed kyi drung du dpal gsang ba'i bdag pos thugs ji ltar bskyed pa dang thugs dam ji ltar bzhes pa de bzhin du bdag gis kyang rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i spyan sngar byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing bslab pa'i gzhi mtha' dag la rjes su bslab par bgyi'o// bdag cag la sogs pa'i sems can thams cad byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du dus ma yin par 'chi ba la sogs pa'i 'jigs pa thams cad 'joms pa dang*/ gdon dang gdug pa can mtha' dag gis mi brdzi zhing de dag thogs pa med par gzhom pa'i mthu thob par gyur cig thabs la mkhas pa'i mngon par shes pa dang*/ ye shes kyi byin rlabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/

bsdu ba'i dngos po mtha' yas pa'i pha rol du son par gyur cig sems kyi skad cig gcig la 'gro ba thams cad kyi bsam pa dang spyod pa'i rjes su 'gro ba'i chos sgo mtha' yas pa rdzogs par ston nus par gyur cig bsam las 'das pa'i gzugs thob nas rnam par snang mdzad kyi dbyings la bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa ji snyed pa de snyed du sprul nas phyi bzhin tu 'brang ba dang glags lta ba'i gegs tshar gcod nus par gyur cig zhing rab 'byams rgya mtsho mtha' yas par rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dam pa'i chos kyi mdzod 'dzin pa la ngal ba dang skyo ba med par gyur cig chos nyid zab mo dbye ba med pa la sangs rgyas thams cad dang nyams pa nyid thob nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba lkog tu ma gyur par rang dbang du spyod nus par gyur cig rdo rje'i rnam par thar pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa yongs su rdzogs te cho 'phrul chen po 'khor ba'i mthar thug par ston nus par gyur cig srid pa nye bar len pa'i 'ching ba thams cad las yongs su grol te srid pa ji srid de srid du srid pa dang mthun pa'i gzugs dang skad sna tshogs pas gang la gang 'dul gyi phan pa mtha' yas pa sgrub nus par gyur cig ye shes chen po'i gzugs kyi dbang thob nas gzhan dang thun mong ma yin pa gsang ba chen po'i mdzad pa rlabs po che sgrub pa la 'gran bya zla dang bral bar gyur cig mdor na dpal gsang ba'i bdag po lag na rdo rje'i rnam thar dang gzungs dang ting nge 'dzin dang smon lam dang thabs la mkhas pa'i spyod yul rnam par 'phrul pa dang ye shes rgya mtsho tshad med pa thams cad bdag gis myur du 'grub nas sems can thams cad kyang de lta bu la 'god nus par gyur cig 'phos ma thag tu dpal gsang ba'i bdag po lag na rdo rje'i zhal mngon sum du mthong ste sgrib pa ma lus pa skad cig la byang nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du thogs pa med par 'jug cing*/
