'gro ba ngan pa'i lam nas bzlog ste mtho ris dang thar pa'i bde ba la 'god par gyur cig sems can gang dag nyon mongs pa dang sdig pa'i grogs pa'i dbang du song nas 'jig rten pha rol la mi 'jigs par lta ba dang*/ mi dge ba'i las kyis chog mi shes pa de dag kyang ngan par lta ba'i sems kyi rgyun las zlog cing yang dag pa'i lta ba dang spyod pa la sbyor bar gyur cig mi dge ba dang ltung ba'i rtsa ba dang 'grogs pa'i mtha' 'khob rnams su so sor skal ba dang 'tshams pa'i gzugs kyis skye zhing 'byung bar ston te thams cad mkhyen pas bshad pa sngon chad ma byung ba'i zab mo'i mdo sde dang ting nge 'dzin dang gzungs dang bzod pa dag ston cing sems 'dul ba dang lus ngag sdom pa dang brtul ba brtan pos rnam par grol ba'i go 'phang la 'god par gyur cig bdag gi ming thos shing gus par byed pa'i sems can gang su'ang rung ba byang chub snying po'i mthar thug gi bar du ltung ba'i rtsa ba rnams dang dus ma yin par 'chi ba la sogs pa'i 'jigs pa chen po rnams dang nad gdon bkres skom dbul phongs rgyal po'i chad pa mi ma yin pa'i gnod pa la sogs pa mtho ris dang thar pa la bar du gcod pa nam du'ang mi 'byung bar bdag nyid yid la byas pas sdig pa zad cing tshogs rlabs po che rdzogs par gyur cig mdor na rgyal ba'i sras mchog nam mkha'i snying po'i rnam thar dang gzungs dang ting nge 'dzin dang smon lam dang thabs la mkhas pa'i spyod yul dang rnam par 'phrul pa dang ye shes rgya mtsho tshad med pa thams cad bdag gis myur du 'grub nas sems can thams cad kyang de lta bu la 'god nus par gyur cig 'phos ma thag tu rgyal ba'i sras mchog nam mkha'i snying po'i zhal mngon sum du mthong ste sgrib pa ma lus pa skad cig la byang nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du thogs pa med par 'jug cing*/ zhing yongs su sbyong ba dang*/

sems can rnams smin par byed pa dang*/ dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin cing phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rnams la mnyes pa mtha' yas pa sgrub par byed par gyur cig/ ༈ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do skyabs su mchi'o// lan bdun/ mchod pa sogs gong bzhin bya/ deng rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i tshogs gdan 'dzom pa'i spyan sngar rgyal sras thu bo 'phags pa kun tu bzang po mtshan nas brjod de tshogs bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba la brten nas/ sngon de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes rdo rje rgya mtsho'i rgyal po la sogs pa'i spyan sngar 'phags pa kun tu bzang pos thugs ji ltar bskyed pa dang thugs dam ji ltar bzhes pa de bzhin tu bdag gis kyang rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i spyan sngar byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing bslab pa'i gzhi mtha' dag la rjes su bslab par bgyi'o// bdag cag la sogs pa'i sems can thams cad skyes bu chen po'i lhag pa'i bsam pa g.yo med cing phun sum tshogs pas bdag don tu byang chub chen po'i spyod pa dang gzhan don tu bzang po spyod pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son par gyur cig bskal pa dang bskal pa rgya mtsho 'byams klas pa rnams su 'jig rten gyi khams gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa grangs med par dpa' bo chen po'i snying stobs kyis chags thogs med par 'jug par gyur cig phyogs bcu'i zhing khams brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa rdul phra rab kyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i zhing re re bzhin yang sangs rgyas rgya mtsho la mchod pa'i bye brag chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pas mchod pa dang*/ dam pa'i chos ma lus pa yongs su 'dzin par gyur cig phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba mdzad pa rmad du byung ba ston pa thams cad kyi zhabs kyi drung du thogs pa med pa'i lus kyis gcig car du bgrod cing bya ba khyad par can byed par gyur cig

rtag tu byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rgya mtsho sgo thams cad nas spyod cing*/ sems can rgya mtsho skad cig re res yongs su smin par byed par gyur cig sangs rgyas kyi zhing rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i rdul snyed bgrang ba las 'das pa bdag gi zhing gcig tu grub cing ngo mtshar gyi bkod pa bsam gyi mi khyab pa dang byang chub sems dpa' mchog gis gang ba sogs dag pa rab 'byams kyi spyod yul 'ba' zhig 'byung bar gyur cig phan mdzad rgyal ba'i sras po gang dag bzhugs pa de dag thams cad dang bsam sbyor mthun par spyod cing*/ spyod pa dang nyams len thams cad don gyi mchog kho na mtha' yas pa 'grub par gyur cig nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i 'jig rten thams cad du mdzad pa'i cho 'phrul mtha' yas shing bsam gyis mi khyab pa ston pa'i tshul gyis mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi smon lam chen po 'bum phrag bcu po la sogs pa sems can kyi don du smon lam tshad med grangs med pa mdzad pa de thams cad bdag gis bde blag tu 'grub par gyur cig stong pa nyid dang snying rje dang thabs la mkhas pa'i ye shes tshad med pas phyogs bcur dus gsum du gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba dang rgyal ba'i mchog rnams kyis rdzogs smin sbyangs pa ji snyed mdzad pa de dag thams cad bdag nyid kho nas 'grub par gyur cig chos kyi dbyings dang nam mkha'i mtha' dang sems can gyi khams dang 'jig rten gyi las dang nyon mongs pa'i mtha' ji srid du smon lam gyis khyab cing mtha' gtugs pa med pas rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i dgongs pa skong bar byed par gyur cig mdor na rgyal ba'i sras kyi thu bo 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam thar dang gzungs dang ting nge 'dzin dang smon lam dang thabs la mkhas pa'i spyod yul dang rnam par 'phrul pa dang ye shes rgya mtsho tshad med pa thams cad bdag gis myur du 'grub nas sems can thams cad kyang de lta bu la 'god nus par gyur cig

'phos ma thag tu 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i zhal mngon sum du mthong ste sgrib pa ma lus pa skad cig la byang nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du thogs pa med par 'jug cing*/ zhing yongs su sbyong ba dang*/ sems can rnams smin par byed pa dang*/ dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin cing phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rnams la mnyes pa mtha' yas pa sgrub par byed par gyur cig gnyis pa gzungs bzla ba ni/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang bcas pa thams cad kyi mthu dang byin gyis brlabs dang*/ chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs dang*/ 'phags pa sku gsung thugs kyi spyod pa ma dag pa mi mnga' ba rnams kyi thugs nges pa'i bden pas gzungs sngags bzlas pa tshul bzhin tu 'grub par byin gyis slob par mdzad de/ bdag sogs 'gro ba mang po'i don dpag tu med pa mdzad par gyur cig sku las 'od zer 'phros pas 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad khyab/ des 'phags pa thams cad sems can gyi don la bskul zhing ngan song gi gnas thams cad sbyangs te sems can thams cad mtho ris dang thar pa'i go 'phang la 'jug par gyur cig 'od zer des bdag cag rnams la khyab pas 'gro don dpag med sgrub nus pa'i mthu thob ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang sku gsung thugs mtshungs par gyur cig bdag cag la sogs pa'i bsgrub bya'i lus dang 'khor dang yo byad thams cad la khyab ste/ nad dang gnod pa thams cad ni bsal/ lus sems kyi skyon thams cad dang ni bral te/ chos kyi snod rung du gyur cig bdag cag rnams kyis 'phags pa rnams mngon sum lta bur dmigs nas gzungs bzlas pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang bcas pa rnams gyi ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo sna tshogs dang tshig 'bru mtha' yas pa rtogs shing rnam par dag par byin gyis slob par gyur cig ces bden tshig gis bsngos nas/

'phags pa rnams kyis gnang zhing phrin las mdzad par nges shes bskyed de ji ltar bsngos pa bzhin mngon tu gyur par dmigs nas/ gtso bo shāka thub kyi gzungs ni/ oṃ bho hūm̐ hūm̐/ ā ā/ hī hī/ shi ba shi ba/ shān+ti shān+ti/ sha ma sha ma/ sha mā pa ya/ ta thā ga tā nu ga ta/ swa bhā ba/ a bhā pa/ sa mut+tā ya/ a sa ma ba la/ a bi ra ba la/ a mi ta ba la/ a ti ba la/ hūm̐ ghum̐ ghum̐/ dhau dhau/ bh+rau bh+rau/ bh+re du bh+re du/ hī hī/ bha ga bān/ bha bān ta ka sur ta bho ga ma hā shān+ti ka ra/ pā pa kalpi ṣa nā sha ka swā hā/ mtshan sngags ni/ na mo bha ga ba te shākya mu na ye ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samya k+saṃ bud+dha ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ mu ni mu ni ma hā mu na ye swā hā/ snying po ni/ oṃ ma hā hūm̐ ma hā bī ra swā hā/ 'jam dpal gyi gzungs ni/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ/ oṃ ra ra sma ra a pra ti ha ta shā sa nāṃ/ ku mā ra rū pa dha ri hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ snying po ni/ oṃ shrī aṃ ram̐ ga swā hā/ spyan ras gzigs kyi gzungs ni/ na mo ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi sa twā ya/ ma hā sa twā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ kā ru ṇe kā ru ṇe/ ma hā kā ru ṇi/ pra tiṣ+ṭhi ti kā ru ṇā ya swā hā/ snying po ni/ oṃ hrī hūm̐ pad+ma pri ya swā hā/ phyag rdor gyi gzungs ni/ na mo badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ ma hā badz+ra pra tiṣ+ṭhi tā ya/ sarba ta thā ga ta sha ri rān+targa tā ya/ badz+ra sha rī raṃ/ me ku ru badz+ra a dhiṣ+ṭhā na swā hā/ snying po ni/ oṃ ku ru bha na ra ha swā hā/ byams pa'i gzungs ni/ oṃ a dzi tañdzā ya/ sarba satwa sa mā ya/ ma nu ga ta swāhā/ snying po ni/ oṃ mai hā rā ṇa swā hā/ sa'i snying po'i gzungs ni/ oṃ suṃ bha ni suṃ bha/ ha ra tsa ra/ ma hā pā sha/ ma ru tā/ a mo gha badz+ra satwa swā hā/ snying po ni/ oṃ k+ṣi ti ha rā dza swā hā/ sgrib sel gyi gzungs ni/ oṃ a mri ta bin+du dza ba ma hā su kha swā hā/

snying po ni/ oṃ na swā raṃ bha swā hā/ nam mkha'i snying po'i gzungs ni/ oṃ swa sti ka ma lāk+ṣi bi pu la saṃ bha ba/ dharma dhā tu go tsa re swā hā/ snying po ni/ oṃ ā ka sha gar+bhā swā hā/ kun tu bzang po'i gzungs ni/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ na mo na ma s+t+ri/ bhu ba ni shwa re/ ma hā bho gā ya/ a sa ma sa ma/ a mi ta sa ma/ a nan+ta sa ma/ ga ga na sa ma/ tri bhu ba na sa ma/ a she ṣa sa ma/ be ṣa sa ma/ pa ra ma ar+tha sa ma/ swa bhā ba sa ma/ ta thā ga tā sa ma/ a ra dzaḥs ma/ shud+dhi sa ma/ bud+dhi sa ma/ dharma ta thā tā sa ma/ a bhi ṣa ma sa ma/ sa ma sa ma/ e kā nā ya/ sā ga ra/ bi shud+dhe/ ā lo ka hī hī/ lab+dha lab+dha/ bi dza ya bi dza ya/ aṃ pra sa ga ra/ na ya na ya/ hi ni ra adhiṣ+ṭhā na/ saṃ bho ga oṃ a na la ya la ya/ dharma a gra/ dha ra dha ra/ dza ya dza ya/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ dha ma dha ma swā hā/ oṃ swaṃ hrīḥka ya swā hā/ snying po ni/ oṃ swā hā hri rā dza ya swā hā/ de dag spyir bzlas grangs ji tsam mang ba legs mod kyi/ dkyus su gzungs rnams tshar bdun nam gsum re tsam dang*/ snying po rnams brgya rtsa re bzla'o// gzungs rnams ni so so'i mtshan brgya sogs gzhung las lan gcig tsam brjod pa la'ang phan yon mtha' yas par bshad pa dang*/ snying po rnams ni dkyil 'khor brgyud pa zhes bya ba las/ snying po 'di dag brjod pa tsam gyis mtshams med pa lnga 'byang zhing dngos grub thams cad 'thob pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi mdun tu lan gcig brjod na de'i don thams cad 'grub cing myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs so// gsum pa spyir smon lam du bya ba ni/ 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang phyogs bcu yi// sogs bzang po spyod pa tshang ba dang*/ 'phags pa klu sgrub zhabs kyi gsung rin chen phreng ba las 'byung ba'i smon lam ni/ de ltar bgyis pa'i bsod nams dang*// bdag gis bgyis dang ma bgyis dang*// des ni sems can thams cad kyang*// bla med byang chub sems ldan shog

/sems can thams cad dri med dbang*// yongs rdzogs mi khom kun 'das shing*// spyod pa rang dbang yod pa dang*// 'tsho ba bzang dang ldan par shog /lus can dag ni thams cad kyang*// lag na rin chen nyid ldan zhing*// yo byad thams cad mtha' yas pa// 'khor ba srid du mi zad shog /bud med thams cad dus kun tu// skyes mchog nyid du 'gyur bar shog /lus can thams cad rig pa dang*// rkang par ldan pa nyid du shog /lus can kha dog bzang ba dang*// gzugs bzang gzi brjid che ba dang*// lta na sdug cing nad med dang*// stobs chen tshe dang ldan par shog /thams cad thabs la mkhas gyur te// sdug bsngal kun las thar ba dang*// dkon mchog gsum la gzhol ba dang*// sangs rgyas chos nor che ldan shog /byams dang snying rje dga' ba dang*// nyon mongs btang snyoms gnas pa dang*// sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod brtson 'grus// bsam gtan shes rab kyis brgyan cing*// chos rnams thams cad yongs rdzogs te// mtshan dang dpe byad gsal ba dang*// bsam gyis mi khyab sa bcu dag /rgyun mi chad par bgrod par shog /bdag kyang yon tan de dag dang*// gzhan kun gyis kyang brgyan ldan te// nyes pa kun las grol ba dang*// sems can kun mchog byams pa dang*// sems can kun yid re ba yi// bsam pa thams cad rdzogs bgyid cing*// rtag tu lus can thams cad kyi// sdug bsngal sel bar bgyid par shog /'jig rten kun na skye bo gang*// su dag 'jigs pas skyo ba de// bdag gi ming tsam thos pas kyang*// shin tu 'jigs pa med par shog /bdag ni mthong dang dran pa dang*// ming tsam thos pa'i skye bo rnams// rab tu 'khrugs med rnal ma dang*// rdzogs pa'i byang chub nges pa dang*// tshe rabs kun tu rjes 'brang ba'i// mngon shes lnga po thob par shog /sems can kun la rnam kun tu// rtag tu phan bde bgyid par shog /'jig rten kun tu skye bo gang*// sdig pa byed par 'dod gyur pa// de dag thams cad gnod med par// rtag tu gcig car bzlog gyur cig

/sa dang chu dang me dang rlung*// sman dang dgon pa'i shing bzhin tu// rtag tu sems can thams cad kyis// rang gar dbang byed spyod par shog /sems can rnams ni srog bzhin 'phangs// de dag bdag las ches 'phangs shog /bdag la de dag sdig smin cing*// bdag dge ma lus der smin shog /ji srid thams cad 'ga' zhig kyang*// gang du ma grol de srid du// de phyir bla na med pa yi// byang chub mchog la gnas gyur cig /ces dang*/ gzhan yang byams smon gyis mtshon pa'i mdo rgyud nas 'byung ba'i smon lam ji ltar nus pa bsam pa thag pa nas kha ton tu bya zhing mi nus na snga ma de dag gis 'thus so// gsum pa cho ga'i rjes ji ltar bya ba la lnga/ gtor mchod 'bul zhing 'dod don gsol ba/ bzod gsol/ gshegs bstim/ bsngo ba/ shis brjod do// dang po ni/ gtor mar chab bran/ mchod pa kha gsos la/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ bh+rūm̐ las byung ba'i gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang*/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa nas/ khaṃ swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs la/ na maḥsarba bud+dha bo dhi satwa sa pa ri bā re bh+yaḥ oṃ a kā ro sogs btags pa lan gsum gyis 'bul/ zhal zas ro brgya ldan zhing yid 'phrog pa// legs sbyar 'di ni rgyal ba sras bcas la// dad pas phul pas 'gro ba 'di dag kun// 'byor ldan ting 'dzin zas la spyod par shog /ces dang*/ 'phags pa'i tshogs de dag thams cad la mchod yon dang*/ sogs gong bzhin brjod/ bcom ldan 'das mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad bdag cag rnams la dgongs su gsol/ khyed rnams la mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba lags pas/

phan bde'i 'byung gnas kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che sgo thams cad nas phyogs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa dang*/ bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu rnams sku tshe brtan cing thugs kyi bzhed pa'i don kun 'bad med du 'grub pa dang*/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib nad gdon 'gal rkyen mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi zhing*/ mthun rkyen chos dang mthun pa'i bsam pa yid bzhin tu 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ yul ris rgyal khams thams cad du'ang nad mug 'khrugs rtsod la sogs pa snyigs ma'i rgud pa mtha' dag ming yang mi grags shing bde skyid rdzogs ldan gyi dga' ston dus rtag tu 'phel bar mdzad du gsol/ khyad par du yang bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pas thog drangs sems can thams cad gnas skabs mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi nas/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bde legs phun sum tshogs pa'i dpal la longs spyod pa dang*/ mthar thug don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ gnyis pa ni/ bdag cag dus ngan pa'i sems can spyod pa dman zhing ma dag pas ma 'tshal ba dang*/ lus ngag yid gsum nyon mongs pa dang 'dres pa dang*/ mchod pa'i dngos po chung zhing dman pa dang*/ gtsang sbras ma phyed pa dang*/ mdo las byung ba'i cho ga bzhin tu ma lcogs pa la sogs pa 'khrul zhing nongs pa thams cad 'phags pa thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams la bzod par gsol zhing mchis na/ thugs brtse bar dgongs te bzod par bzhes shing 'phral dang yun tu bdag cag gi sgrib par mi 'gyur bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ gsum pa ni/ mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa khyed rnams kyis bdag cag dang sems can thams cad kyi don mdzad lags kyi so so'i zhing khams su 'khor dang bcas pa gshegs su gsol/

slar yang sems can don la thugs rjes 'byon par zhu/ sku rten sogs yod na brtan bzhugs spyi mthun byas kyang chog go /bzhi pa ni/ rgyas par rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi bsngo ba brjod/ bsdu na/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid// thob nas nyes pa'i dgra rnams pham byas nas// skye rga na 'chi rba rlabs 'khrugs pa yi// srid pa'i mtsho las 'gro ba sgrol bar shog /lnga pa ni/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba sogs zhal nas gsungs pa'i tshigs su bcad pas thog drangs te shis brjod rgyas par bya zhing dge legs kyi me tog char du bsnyil bar bya'o// lam srol gsar du dbye ba'i shing rta mkhan// min kyang nges pa'i gnad kyi sgo mthong zhing*// byin rlabs chu rgyun bar ma chad thob pas// mdo don nyams len snying po'i bcud du dril// bde gshegs sras bcas smon lam rgya mtsho bzung*// byang chub sems gnyis bskyed pa'i skal bzang la// skye dgu kun spyod kun kyang rgyal ba dang*// rgyal sras rnams kyi rnam thar myur rdzogs shog /byang chub kyi sems rin po che rdzogs smin sbyong ba bde blag tu 'grub pa'i thabs khyad par can 'di nyid/ rgyal sras 'phags pa de dag gi byin rlabs mtshan ma cung zad thob pa rgyur byas ring mo nas bgyid 'dun yid la brnags kyang snyom las su gyur pa la/ byang chub sems rnam pa gnyis g.yar dam du 'chang zhing sde snod 'dzin pa mkhan bla ma karma bkra shis 'od zer rab tu rgyas pa'i sdes yi ge'i mthun rkyen mdzad pas mtshams sbyar te/ mang du thos shing phyogs bral gyi dge sbyong karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'am/ blo gros mtha' yas pa'i sdes dpal de bī ko ṭa'i dben khrod du rang lo drug cur zin pa rab tshes chu sprel gnam lo gsar du bzhad pa'i dga' ston tu grub par bgyis pa dge legs 'phel// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/
